post_title: Will the 2026 World Series require a Game 6?

question.title: Will the 2026 World Series require a Game 6?
question.description:
The 2026 World Series is the championship series of Major League Baseball, a best-of-seven contest in which the first team to win four games wins the title. Game 1 is scheduled for October 23, 2026. The National League champion Milwaukee Brewers (a franchise-record 103-59 regular season) earned home-field advantage and host Games 1, 2, 6, and 7. Their opponent is the winner of the American League Championship Series between the Cleveland Guardians and Tampa Bay Rays, which as of October 16, 2026 the Guardians led 2 games to 1.

Per MLB's official schedule, Game 5 is October 28, Game 6 is October 30, and a decisive Game 7 (if needed) would be October 31. A Game 6 is only played if the series is not decided in the first five games — that is, if the series is tied 3-2 after Game 5. If either team reaches four wins in four or five games (a sweep or a 4-1 result), the series ends and no Game 6 is played.

The Brewers entered the World Series as favorites after sweeping both earlier playoff rounds, and short series are common: of recent World Series, a meaningful share end in four or five games. Historically, roughly 40-45% of best-of-seven World Series have ended in four or five games, meaning a Game 6 was not needed, while the remainder reached at least six games.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves YES if a Game 6 is played in the 2026 Major League Baseball World Series between the Milwaukee Brewers and the American League champion (the winner of the Guardians–Rays ALCS). Game 6 is scheduled for Friday, October 30, 2026. A Game 6 is required (and thus played) only if neither team has won four games after the first five games — i.e., the series stands at 3 games to 2 after Game 5. The question resolves NO if the series is decided in four or five games, so that no sixth game is necessary. Resolution is based on the official 2026 World Series results page at Baseball-Reference (https://www.baseball-reference.com/postseason/2026_WS.shtml), or [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) if that page is unavailable.
question.fine_print: If the World Series is canceled or shortened such that no Game 6 can occur, the question resolves NO. A Game 6 that is scheduled and officially begins but is later suspended or postponed still counts as a Game 6 being played, resolving YES.
